question: The movie RRR has recently been honoured with the prestigious Golden Globe award for the Best Original Song for the track ‘Natu Natu’. Who are the singers of this song ?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Rahul Sipligunj and Kaala Bhairava**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahul Sipligunj** and **Kaala Bhairava** are the singers of the track '**Naatu Naatu**' from the movie **RRR**.
 
• The song '**Naatu Naatu**' was composed by the celebrated music director **M. M. Keeravani**.
 
• The movie **RRR**, directed by **S. S. Rajamouli**, is a globally acclaimed Indian epic drama.
 
• '**Naatu Naatu**' won the **Golden Globe Award** for **Best Original Song** in 2023, marking a historic achievement for Indian cinema on an international platform.
 
• The energetic and rhythmic song celebrates **friendship**, **culture**, and **dance**.
 
• **Rahul Sipligunj** is a playback singer and independent musician from **Telangana**, known for his versatility in Telugu music.
 
• **Kaala Bhairava**, the son of music composer **M. M. Keeravani**, is a talented playback singer and music composer in the Telugu film industry.
 
• The song became a viral sensation due to its **catchy beats**, **high-energy choreography**, and its ability to connect with audiences worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Silambarasan TR and Vineeth Sreenivasan**__

 __
 
• **Silambarasan TR**, popularly known as **Simbu**, is a Tamil actor, singer, and filmmaker, primarily active in the Tamil cinema industry.
 
• **Vineeth Sreenivasan** is a Malayalam playback singer, actor, and director, widely recognized in the Malayalam film industry.
 
• While both are renowned in their respective industries, they were not associated with the song '**Naatu Naatu**'.
 
 
 
• **KJ Yesudas and Anirudh Ravichander**__
 __
 
• **KJ Yesudas** is a legendary Indian classical musician and playback singer with a career spanning over six decades.
 
• **Anirudh Ravichander** is a contemporary Tamil music composer and playback singer, known for his chart-topping hits.
 
• Neither of them contributed to the song '**Naatu Naatu**' in the movie **RRR**.
 
 
 
• **Shankar Mahadevan and Rajesh Krishnan**__
 
 
• **Shankar Mahadevan** is a celebrated Indian music composer and playback singer, part of the famous **Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy** trio.
 
• **Rajesh Krishnan** is a noted playback singer in the Kannada film industry.
 
• Although both are highly respected in Indian music, they did not perform the song '**Naatu Naatu**'.
